intent: Category grouping must normalise as much as the display does. skills-grouping.ts:36 keys on raw.toLowerCase() while titleCaseCategory ALSO folds [-_]+ to spaces, so 'Control Hub' and 'controlhub' become two buckets rendering near-identical labels (QA saw CONTROL HUB (6) beside CONTROLHUB (1)). Since T-0032 the key is load-bearing: collapse and paging state key off it, so a split bucket splits its state too. NOTE the existing test pins the buggy behaviour ('Fine-Tuning' -> 'fine-tuning' while the display renders 'Fine Tuning'); it must be corrected, not deleted. Source: the operator's live Hermes QA pass on dev@43d16c30, 2026-08-26. Root cause traced by three read-only investigations and re-verified independently; NOT a regression from the consolidation work, which only put a QA pass in front of pages nobody had text-scraped before.
